namespace LeanProofs.ZFCinPA.ModelCodedFreeRenaming
open LO LO.FirstOrder LO.FirstOrder.Arithmetic
open LO.FirstOrder.Arithmetic.Bootstrapping
open scoped LO.FirstOrder.Arithmetic
variable {V : Type*} [ORingStructure V] [V↓[ℒₒᵣ] ⊧* 𝗜𝚺₁]
variable {L : Language} [L.Encodable] [L.LORDefinable]

/-- On the unprotected tail this is `lift^level (η_chosen ∘ (+offset))`,
where η sends its chosen label to zero and sends every other label x to x+1.
The additive comparison avoids truncated subtraction in the fixed graph. -/
noncomputable def renameIndex (chosen level offset x : V) : V := by
  classical
  exact if x < level then x else if x+offset = level+chosen then level else x+offset+1

def renameIndexDef : 𝚺₁.Semisentence 5 := .mkSigma “out chosen level offset x.
  (x < level ∧ out = x) ∨
  (level ≤ x ∧ ((x+offset = level+chosen ∧ out = level) ∨
    (x+offset ≠ level+chosen ∧ out = x+offset+1)))”
instance renameIndex_defined :
    𝚺₁-Function₄[V] renameIndex via renameIndexDef := .mk fun e => by
  classical
  by_cases h : e 4 < e 2 <;>
    by_cases he : e 4+e 3 = e 2+e 1 <;>
    simp [renameIndexDef,renameIndex,h,he,not_lt] at *
instance renameIndex_definable : 𝚫₁-Function₄[V] renameIndex :=
  renameIndex_defined.graph_delta.to_definable

@[simp] lemma renameIndex_lift_zero (chosen level offset : V) :
    renameIndex chosen (level+1) offset 0 = 0 := by
  simp [renameIndex]
lemma renameIndex_lift_succ (chosen level offset x : V) :
    renameIndex chosen (level+1) offset (x+1) =
      renameIndex chosen level offset x+1 := by
  classical
  have hlt : x+1 < level+1 ↔ x < level := by simp
  have heq : (x+1)+offset = (level+1)+chosen ↔ x+offset = level+chosen := by
    constructor
    · intro h
      have h' : (x+offset)+1 = (level+chosen)+1 := by
        simpa only [add_assoc,add_comm,add_left_comm] using h
      simpa only [add_right_inj] using h'
    · intro h
      simpa only [add_assoc,add_comm,add_left_comm] using congrArg (fun z : V => z+1) h
  by_cases h : x < level <;> by_cases he : x+offset = level+chosen <;>
    simp [renameIndex,hlt,heq,h,he,add_assoc]
lemma renameIndex_offset_succ (chosen offset x : V) :
    renameIndex chosen 0 offset (x+1) = renameIndex chosen 0 (offset+1) x := by
  classical
  simp [renameIndex,add_assoc,add_comm,add_left_comm]

namespace TermRenamer

def blueprint : Language.TermRec.Blueprint 3 where
  bvar := .mkSigma “out z chosen level offset. !qqBvarDef out z”
  fvar := .mkSigma “out x chosen level offset. ∃ y,
    !renameIndexDef y chosen level offset x ∧ !qqFvarDef out y”
  func := .mkSigma “out arity f oldArgs newArgs chosen level offset.
    !qqFuncDef out arity f newArgs”
noncomputable def construction : Language.TermRec.Construction V blueprint where
  bvar _ z := ^#z
  fvar parameters x := ^&(renameIndex (parameters 0) (parameters 1) (parameters 2) x)
  func _ arity f _ newArgs := ^func arity f newArgs
  bvar_defined := .mk fun e => by simp [blueprint]
  fvar_defined := .mk fun e => by simp [blueprint]
  func_defined := .mk fun e => by simp [blueprint]
end TermRenamer

noncomputable def termRename (L : Language) [L.Encodable] [L.LORDefinable]
    (chosen level offset term : V) : V :=
  TermRenamer.construction.result L ![chosen,level,offset] term
noncomputable def termRenameVec (L : Language) [L.Encodable] [L.LORDefinable]
    (chosen level offset arity terms : V) : V :=
  TermRenamer.construction.resultVec L ![chosen,level,offset] arity terms
noncomputable def termRenameDef (L : Language) [L.Encodable] [L.LORDefinable] :
    𝚺₁.Semisentence 5 :=
  (TermRenamer.blueprint.result L).rew (Rew.subst ![#0,#4,#1,#2,#3])
noncomputable def termRenameVecDef (L : Language) [L.Encodable] [L.LORDefinable] :
    𝚺₁.Semisentence 6 :=
  (TermRenamer.blueprint.resultVec L).rew (Rew.subst ![#0,#4,#5,#1,#2,#3])
instance termRename_defined :
    𝚺₁-Function₄[V] (termRename L) via termRenameDef L := .mk fun e => by
  simpa [termRenameDef,termRename,Matrix.comp_vecCons'',Matrix.comp_vecCons']
    using (TermRenamer.construction.result_defined (L := L)).defined
      ![e 0,e 4,e 1,e 2,e 3]
instance termRenameVec_defined :
    𝚺₁-Function₅[V] (termRenameVec L) via termRenameVecDef L := .mk fun e => by
  simpa [termRenameVecDef,termRenameVec,Matrix.comp_vecCons'',Matrix.comp_vecCons']
    using (TermRenamer.construction.resultVec_defined (L := L)).defined
      ![e 0,e 4,e 5,e 1,e 2,e 3]
instance termRename_delta : 𝚫₁-Function₄[V] (termRename L) :=
  termRename_defined.graph_delta.to_definable
instance termRenameVec_delta : 𝚫₁.DefinableFunction₅ (termRenameVec (V := V) L) :=
  termRenameVec_defined.graph_delta.to_definable

@[simp] lemma termRename_bvar (chosen level offset z : V) :
    termRename L chosen level offset (^#z) = ^#z := by
  simp [termRename,TermRenamer.construction]
@[simp] lemma termRename_fvar (chosen level offset x : V) :
    termRename L chosen level offset (^&x) = ^&(renameIndex chosen level offset x) := by
  simp [termRename,TermRenamer.construction]
lemma termRename_func (chosen level offset : V) {arity f terms : V}
    (hf : L.IsFunc arity f) (ht : IsUTermVec L arity terms) :
    termRename L chosen level offset (^func arity f terms) =
      ^func arity f (termRenameVec L chosen level offset arity terms) := by
  simp [termRename,termRenameVec,TermRenamer.construction,hf,ht]
@[simp] lemma termRenameVec_lh (chosen level offset : V) {arity terms : V}
    (ht : IsUTermVec L arity terms) :
    len (termRenameVec L chosen level offset arity terms) = arity :=
  TermRenamer.construction.resultVec_lh L ![chosen,level,offset] ht
lemma nth_termRenameVec (chosen level offset : V) {arity terms i : V}
    (ht : IsUTermVec L arity terms) (hi : i < arity) :
    (termRenameVec L chosen level offset arity terms).[i] =
      termRename L chosen level offset terms.[i] :=
  TermRenamer.construction.nth_resultVec L ![chosen,level,offset] ht hi

lemma termRename_isUTerm (chosen level offset : V) {term : V} (ht : IsUTerm L term) :
    IsUTerm L (termRename L chosen level offset term) := by
  apply IsUTerm.induction 𝚺 ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ term ht
  · definability
  · intro z; simp
  · intro x; simp
  · intro arity f terms hf hv ih
    rw [termRename_func chosen level offset hf hv]
    refine IsUTerm.func hf ⟨(termRenameVec_lh chosen level offset hv).symm,?_⟩
    intro i hi
    rw [nth_termRenameVec chosen level offset hv hi]
    exact ih i hi
lemma termRenameVec_isUTerm (chosen level offset : V) {arity terms : V}
    (ht : IsUTermVec L arity terms) :
    IsUTermVec L arity (termRenameVec L chosen level offset arity terms) := by
  refine ⟨(termRenameVec_lh chosen level offset ht).symm,?_⟩
  intro i hi
  rw [nth_termRenameVec chosen level offset ht hi]
  exact termRename_isUTerm chosen level offset (ht.nth hi)

lemma termRename_isSemiterm (chosen level offset : V) {depth term : V}
    (ht : IsSemiterm L depth term) :
    IsSemiterm L depth (termRename L chosen level offset term) := by
  apply IsSemiterm.induction 𝚺 ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ term ht
  · definability
  · intro z hz; simpa
  · intro x; simp
  · intro arity f terms hf hv ih
    rw [termRename_func chosen level offset hf hv.isUTerm]
    refine IsSemiterm.func.mpr ⟨hf,?_⟩
    apply IsSemitermVec.iff.mpr
    refine ⟨termRenameVec_lh chosen level offset hv.isUTerm,?_⟩
    intro i hi
    rw [nth_termRenameVec chosen level offset hv.isUTerm hi]
    exact ih i hi
lemma termRenameVec_isSemiterm (chosen level offset : V) {depth arity terms : V}
    (ht : IsSemitermVec L arity depth terms) :
    IsSemitermVec L arity depth (termRenameVec L chosen level offset arity terms) := by
  apply IsSemitermVec.iff.mpr
  refine ⟨termRenameVec_lh chosen level offset ht.isUTerm,?_⟩
  intro i hi
  rw [nth_termRenameVec chosen level offset ht.isUTerm hi]
  exact termRename_isSemiterm chosen level offset (ht.nth hi)

namespace FormulaRenamer
noncomputable def blueprint (L : Language) [L.Encodable] [L.LORDefinable] :
    UformulaRec1.Blueprint where
  rel := .mkSigma “out state arity R terms. ∃ chosen, !pi₁Def chosen state ∧
    ∃ rest, !pi₂Def rest state ∧ ∃ level, !pi₁Def level rest ∧
    ∃ offset, !pi₂Def offset rest ∧ ∃ args,
    !(termRenameVecDef L) args chosen level offset arity terms ∧ !qqRelDef out arity R args”
  nrel := .mkSigma “out state arity R terms. ∃ chosen, !pi₁Def chosen state ∧
    ∃ rest, !pi₂Def rest state ∧ ∃ level, !pi₁Def level rest ∧
    ∃ offset, !pi₂Def offset rest ∧ ∃ args,
    !(termRenameVecDef L) args chosen level offset arity terms ∧ !qqNRelDef out arity R args”
  verum := .mkSigma “out state. !qqVerumDef out”
  falsum := .mkSigma “out state. !qqFalsumDef out”
  and := .mkSigma “out state p q left right. !qqAndDef out left right”
  or := .mkSigma “out state p q left right. !qqOrDef out left right”
  all := .mkSigma “out state p body. !qqAllDef out body”
  exs := .mkSigma “out state p body. !qqExsDef out body”
  allChanges := .mkSigma “next state. next = state”
  exsChanges := .mkSigma “next state. next = state”
noncomputable def construction (L : Language) [L.Encodable] [L.LORDefinable] :
    UformulaRec1.Construction V (blueprint L) where
  rel state arity R terms :=
    ^rel arity R (termRenameVec L (π₁ state) (π₁ (π₂ state)) (π₂ (π₂ state)) arity terms)
  nrel state arity R terms :=
    ^nrel arity R (termRenameVec L (π₁ state) (π₁ (π₂ state)) (π₂ (π₂ state)) arity terms)
  verum _ := ^⊤
  falsum _ := ^⊥
  and _ _ _ left right := left ^⋏ right
  or _ _ _ left right := left ^⋎ right
  all _ _ body := ^∀ body
  exs _ _ body := ^∃ body
  allChanges state := state
  exsChanges state := state
  rel_defined := .mk fun e => by simp [blueprint]
  nrel_defined := .mk fun e => by simp [blueprint]
  verum_defined := .mk fun e => by simp [blueprint]
  falsum_defined := .mk fun e => by simp [blueprint]
  and_defined := .mk fun e => by simp [blueprint]
  or_defined := .mk fun e => by simp [blueprint]
  all_defined := .mk fun e => by simp [blueprint]
  exs_defined := .mk fun e => by simp [blueprint]
  allChanges_defined := .mk fun e => by simp [blueprint]
  exChanges_defined := .mk fun e => by simp [blueprint]
end FormulaRenamer

noncomputable def rename (L : Language) [L.Encodable] [L.LORDefinable]
    (chosen level offset formula : V) : V :=
  (FormulaRenamer.construction L).result L ⟪chosen,⟪level,offset⟫⟫ formula
noncomputable def rawRenameDef (L : Language) [L.Encodable] [L.LORDefinable] :
    𝚺₁.Semisentence 3 := (FormulaRenamer.blueprint L).result L
noncomputable def renameDef (L : Language) [L.Encodable] [L.LORDefinable] :
    𝚺₁.Semisentence 5 := .mkSigma “out chosen level offset formula.
      ∃ rest, !pairDef rest level offset ∧ ∃ state, !pairDef state chosen rest ∧
      !(rawRenameDef L) out state formula”
instance rename_defined :
    𝚺₁-Function₄[V] (rename L) via renameDef L := .mk fun e => by
  simpa [renameDef,rawRenameDef,rename]
    using (FormulaRenamer.construction L).result_defined.defined
      ![e 0,⟪e 1,⟪e 2,e 3⟫⟫,e 4]
instance rename_delta : 𝚫₁-Function₄[V] (rename L) :=
  rename_defined.graph_delta.to_definable

lemma rename_rel (chosen level offset : V) {arity R terms : V}
    (hR : L.IsRel arity R) (ht : IsUTermVec L arity terms) :
    rename L chosen level offset (^rel arity R terms) =
      ^rel arity R (termRenameVec L chosen level offset arity terms) := by
  simp [rename,FormulaRenamer.construction,hR,ht]
lemma rename_nrel (chosen level offset : V) {arity R terms : V}
    (hR : L.IsRel arity R) (ht : IsUTermVec L arity terms) :
    rename L chosen level offset (^nrel arity R terms) =
      ^nrel arity R (termRenameVec L chosen level offset arity terms) := by
  simp [rename,FormulaRenamer.construction,hR,ht]
@[simp] lemma rename_verum (chosen level offset : V) :
    rename L chosen level offset ^⊤ = ^⊤ := by
  simp [rename,FormulaRenamer.construction]
@[simp] lemma rename_falsum (chosen level offset : V) :
    rename L chosen level offset ^⊥ = ^⊥ := by
  simp [rename,FormulaRenamer.construction]
lemma rename_and (chosen level offset : V) {p q : V}
    (hp : IsUFormula L p) (hq : IsUFormula L q) :
    rename L chosen level offset (p ^⋏ q) =
      rename L chosen level offset p ^⋏ rename L chosen level offset q := by
  simp [rename,FormulaRenamer.construction,hp,hq]
lemma rename_or (chosen level offset : V) {p q : V}
    (hp : IsUFormula L p) (hq : IsUFormula L q) :
    rename L chosen level offset (p ^⋎ q) =
      rename L chosen level offset p ^⋎ rename L chosen level offset q := by
  simp [rename,FormulaRenamer.construction,hp,hq]
lemma rename_all (chosen level offset : V) {p : V} (hp : IsUFormula L p) :
    rename L chosen level offset (^∀ p) = ^∀ (rename L chosen level offset p) := by
  simp [rename,FormulaRenamer.construction,hp]
lemma rename_exs (chosen level offset : V) {p : V} (hp : IsUFormula L p) :
    rename L chosen level offset (^∃ p) = ^∃ (rename L chosen level offset p) := by
  simp [rename,FormulaRenamer.construction,hp]

lemma rename_isSemiformula (chosen level offset : V) {depth p : V}
    (hp : IsSemiformula L depth p) :
    IsSemiformula L depth (rename L chosen level offset p) := by
  apply IsSemiformula.sigma1_structural_induction (P := fun depth p =>
    IsSemiformula L depth (rename L chosen level offset p))
    ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ hp
  · definability
  · intro depth arity R terms hR ht
    rw [rename_rel chosen level offset hR ht.isUTerm]
    exact IsSemiformula.rel.mpr ⟨hR,termRenameVec_isSemiterm chosen level offset ht⟩
  · intro depth arity R terms hR ht
    rw [rename_nrel chosen level offset hR ht.isUTerm]
    exact IsSemiformula.nrel.mpr ⟨hR,termRenameVec_isSemiterm chosen level offset ht⟩
  · intro depth; simp
  · intro depth; simp
  · intro depth p q hp hq ihp ihq
    rw [rename_and chosen level offset hp.isUFormula hq.isUFormula]
    exact IsSemiformula.and.mpr ⟨ihp,ihq⟩
  · intro depth p q hp hq ihp ihq
    rw [rename_or chosen level offset hp.isUFormula hq.isUFormula]
    exact IsSemiformula.or.mpr ⟨ihp,ihq⟩
  · intro depth p hp ih
    rw [rename_all chosen level offset hp.isUFormula]
    simpa using ih
  · intro depth p hp ih
    rw [rename_exs chosen level offset hp.isUFormula]
    simpa using ih
lemma rename_isUFormula (chosen level offset : V) {p : V} (hp : IsUFormula L p) :
    IsUFormula L (rename L chosen level offset p) :=
  (rename_isSemiformula chosen level offset hp.isSemiformula).isUFormula

lemma termRename_shift_lift (chosen level offset : V) {term : V} (ht : IsUTerm L term) :
    termRename L chosen (level+1) offset (termShift L term) =
      termShift L (termRename L chosen level offset term) := by
  apply IsUTerm.induction 𝚺 ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ term ht
  · definability
  · intro z; simp
  · intro x; simp [renameIndex_lift_succ]
  · intro arity f terms hf hv ih
    rw [termShift_func hf hv,
      termRename_func chosen (level+1) offset hf hv.termShiftVec]
    rw [termRename_func chosen level offset hf hv,
      termShift_func hf (termRenameVec_isUTerm chosen level offset hv)]
    apply congrArg (fun args => ^func arity f args)
    apply nth_ext' arity
    · simp [hv]
    · simp [hv,termRenameVec_isUTerm]
    · intro i hi
      rw [nth_termRenameVec chosen (level+1) offset hv.termShiftVec hi,
        nth_termShiftVec hv hi]
      rw [nth_termShiftVec (termRenameVec_isUTerm chosen level offset hv) hi,
        nth_termRenameVec chosen level offset hv hi]
      exact ih i hi
lemma termRenameVec_shift_lift (chosen level offset : V) {arity terms : V}
    (ht : IsUTermVec L arity terms) :
    termRenameVec L chosen (level+1) offset arity (termShiftVec L arity terms) =
      termShiftVec L arity (termRenameVec L chosen level offset arity terms) := by
  apply nth_ext' arity
  · simp [ht]
  · simp [ht,termRenameVec_isUTerm]
  · intro i hi
    rw [nth_termRenameVec chosen (level+1) offset ht.termShiftVec hi,
      nth_termShiftVec ht hi]
    rw [nth_termShiftVec (termRenameVec_isUTerm chosen level offset ht) hi,
      nth_termRenameVec chosen level offset ht hi]
    exact termRename_shift_lift chosen level offset (ht.nth hi)
/-- Positive-level SHIFT commutation. -/
lemma rename_shift_lift (chosen level offset : V) {p : V} (hp : IsUFormula L p) :
    rename L chosen (level+1) offset (shift L p) = shift L (rename L chosen level offset p) := by
  apply IsUFormula.ISigma1.sigma1_succ_induction ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ p hp
  · definability
  · intro arity R terms hR ht
    rw [shift_rel hR ht,rename_rel chosen (level+1) offset hR ht.termShiftVec,
      termRenameVec_shift_lift chosen level offset ht,
      rename_rel chosen level offset hR ht]
    rw [shift_rel hR (termRenameVec_isUTerm chosen level offset ht)]
  · intro arity R terms hR ht
    rw [shift_nrel hR ht,rename_nrel chosen (level+1) offset hR ht.termShiftVec,
      termRenameVec_shift_lift chosen level offset ht,
      rename_nrel chosen level offset hR ht]
    rw [shift_nrel hR (termRenameVec_isUTerm chosen level offset ht)]
  · simp
  · simp
  · intro p q hp hq ihp ihq
    rw [shift_and hp hq,
      rename_and chosen (level+1) offset hp.shift hq.shift,
      rename_and chosen level offset hp hq,ihp,ihq]
    rw [shift_and (rename_isUFormula chosen level offset hp)
      (rename_isUFormula chosen level offset hq)]
  · intro p q hp hq ihp ihq
    rw [shift_or hp hq,
      rename_or chosen (level+1) offset hp.shift hq.shift,
      rename_or chosen level offset hp hq,ihp,ihq]
    rw [shift_or (rename_isUFormula chosen level offset hp)
      (rename_isUFormula chosen level offset hq)]
  · intro p hp ih
    rw [shift_all hp,rename_all chosen (level+1) offset hp.shift,
      rename_all chosen level offset hp,ih]
    rw [shift_all (rename_isUFormula chosen level offset hp)]
  · intro p hp ih
    rw [shift_exs hp,rename_exs chosen (level+1) offset hp.shift,
      rename_exs chosen level offset hp,ih]
    rw [shift_exs (rename_isUFormula chosen level offset hp)]

lemma termRename_shift_offset (chosen offset : V) {term : V} (ht : IsUTerm L term) :
    termRename L chosen 0 offset (termShift L term) =
      termRename L chosen 0 (offset+1) term := by
  apply IsUTerm.induction 𝚺 ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ term ht
  · definability
  · intro z; simp
  · intro x; simp [renameIndex_offset_succ]
  · intro arity f terms hf hv ih
    rw [termShift_func hf hv,
      termRename_func chosen 0 offset hf hv.termShiftVec]
    rw [termRename_func chosen 0 (offset+1) hf hv]
    apply congrArg (fun args => ^func arity f args)
    apply nth_ext' arity
    · simp [hv]
    · simp [hv,termRenameVec_isUTerm]
    · intro i hi
      rw [nth_termRenameVec chosen 0 offset hv.termShiftVec hi,
        nth_termShiftVec hv hi]
      rw [nth_termRenameVec chosen 0 (offset+1) hv hi]
      exact ih i hi
lemma termRenameVec_shift_offset (chosen offset : V) {arity terms : V}
    (ht : IsUTermVec L arity terms) :
    termRenameVec L chosen 0 offset arity (termShiftVec L arity terms) =
      termRenameVec L chosen 0 (offset+1) arity terms := by
  apply nth_ext' arity
  · simp [ht]
  · simp [ht,termRenameVec_isUTerm]
  · intro i hi
    rw [nth_termRenameVec chosen 0 offset ht.termShiftVec hi,
      nth_termShiftVec ht hi]
    rw [nth_termRenameVec chosen 0 (offset+1) ht hi]
    exact termRename_shift_offset chosen offset (ht.nth hi)
/-- The level-zero SHIFT case consumes one offset instead of requiring an inverse SHIFT. -/
lemma rename_shift_offset (chosen offset : V) {p : V} (hp : IsUFormula L p) :
    rename L chosen 0 offset (shift L p) = rename L chosen 0 (offset+1) p := by
  apply IsUFormula.ISigma1.sigma1_succ_induction ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ p hp
  · definability
  · intro arity R terms hR ht
    rw [shift_rel hR ht,rename_rel chosen 0 offset hR ht.termShiftVec,
      termRenameVec_shift_offset chosen offset ht,
      rename_rel chosen 0 (offset+1) hR ht]
  · intro arity R terms hR ht
    rw [shift_nrel hR ht,rename_nrel chosen 0 offset hR ht.termShiftVec,
      termRenameVec_shift_offset chosen offset ht,
      rename_nrel chosen 0 (offset+1) hR ht]
  · simp
  · simp
  · intro p q hp hq ihp ihq
    rw [shift_and hp hq,
      rename_and chosen 0 offset hp.shift hq.shift,
      rename_and chosen 0 (offset+1) hp hq,ihp,ihq]
  · intro p q hp hq ihp ihq
    rw [shift_or hp hq,
      rename_or chosen 0 offset hp.shift hq.shift,
      rename_or chosen 0 (offset+1) hp hq,ihp,ihq]
  · intro p hp ih
    rw [shift_all hp,rename_all chosen 0 offset hp.shift,
      rename_all chosen 0 (offset+1) hp,ih]
  · intro p hp ih
    rw [shift_exs hp,rename_exs chosen 0 offset hp.shift,
      rename_exs chosen 0 (offset+1) hp,ih]

lemma termRename_bShift (chosen level offset : V) {term : V} (ht : IsUTerm L term) :
    termRename L chosen level offset (termBShift L term) =
      termBShift L (termRename L chosen level offset term) := by
  apply IsUTerm.induction 𝚺 ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ term ht
  · definability
  · intro z; simp
  · intro x; simp
  · intro arity f terms hf hv ih
    rw [termBShift_func hf hv,
      termRename_func chosen level offset hf hv.isSemitermVec.termBShiftVec.isUTerm,
      termRename_func chosen level offset hf hv,
      termBShift_func hf (termRenameVec_isUTerm chosen level offset hv)]
    apply congrArg (fun args => ^func arity f args)
    apply nth_ext' arity
    · simp [hv]
    · simp [hv,termRenameVec_isUTerm]
    · intro i hi
      rw [nth_termRenameVec chosen level offset hv.isSemitermVec.termBShiftVec.isUTerm hi,
        nth_termBShiftVec hv hi,
        nth_termBShiftVec (termRenameVec_isUTerm chosen level offset hv) hi,
        nth_termRenameVec chosen level offset hv hi]
      exact ih i hi
lemma termRename_qVec (chosen level offset : V) {n m vector : V}
    (hw : IsSemitermVec L n m vector) :
    termRenameVec L chosen level offset (n+1) (qVec L vector) =
      qVec L (termRenameVec L chosen level offset n vector) := by
  apply nth_ext' (n+1)
  · simp [hw.isUTerm,hw.lh]
  · simp [termRenameVec_isUTerm chosen level offset hw.isUTerm,hw.lh]
  · intro i hi
    rw [nth_termRenameVec chosen level offset hw.qVec.isUTerm hi]
    rcases zero_or_succ i with rfl | ⟨i,rfl⟩
    · simp [Bootstrapping.qVec]
    · have hin : i < n := by simpa using hi
      simp only [Bootstrapping.qVec,nth_adjoin_succ,hw.lh,
        termRenameVec_lh chosen level offset hw.isUTerm]
      rw [nth_termBShiftVec hw.isUTerm hin,
        nth_termBShiftVec (termRenameVec_isUTerm chosen level offset hw.isUTerm)
          (by simpa using hin),
        nth_termRenameVec chosen level offset hw.isUTerm hin,
        termRename_bShift chosen level offset (hw.nth hin).isUTerm]

lemma termRename_subst (chosen level offset : V) {n m term vector : V}
    (ht : IsSemiterm L n term) (hw : IsSemitermVec L n m vector) :
    termRename L chosen level offset (termSubst L vector term) =
      termSubst L (termRenameVec L chosen level offset n vector)
        (termRename L chosen level offset term) := by
  apply IsSemiterm.induction 𝚺 ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ term ht
  · definability
  · intro z hz
    simp [termSubst_bvar,nth_termRenameVec chosen level offset hw.isUTerm hz]
  · intro x; simp
  · intro arity f terms hf hv ih
    rw [termSubst_func hf hv.isUTerm,
      termRename_func chosen level offset hf (hw.termSubstVec hv).isUTerm,
      termRename_func chosen level offset hf hv.isUTerm,
      termSubst_func hf (termRenameVec_isUTerm chosen level offset hv.isUTerm)]
    apply congrArg (fun args => ^func arity f args)
    apply nth_ext' arity
    · simp [hv.isUTerm,hw.termSubstVec hv]
    · simp [termRenameVec_isUTerm chosen level offset hv.isUTerm]
    · intro i hi
      rw [nth_termRenameVec chosen level offset (hw.termSubstVec hv).isUTerm hi,
        nth_termSubstVec hv.isUTerm hi,
        nth_termSubstVec (termRenameVec_isUTerm chosen level offset hv.isUTerm) hi,
        nth_termRenameVec chosen level offset hv.isUTerm hi]
      exact ih i hi
lemma termRenameVec_subst (chosen level offset : V) {n m arity terms vector : V}
    (ht : IsSemitermVec L arity n terms) (hw : IsSemitermVec L n m vector) :
    termRenameVec L chosen level offset arity (termSubstVec L arity vector terms) =
      termSubstVec L arity (termRenameVec L chosen level offset n vector)
        (termRenameVec L chosen level offset arity terms) := by
  apply nth_ext' arity
  · simp [hw.termSubstVec ht]
  · simp [termRenameVec_isUTerm chosen level offset ht.isUTerm]
  · intro i hi
    rw [nth_termRenameVec chosen level offset (hw.termSubstVec ht).isUTerm hi,
      nth_termSubstVec ht.isUTerm hi,
      nth_termSubstVec (termRenameVec_isUTerm chosen level offset ht.isUTerm) hi,
      nth_termRenameVec chosen level offset ht.isUTerm hi]
    exact termRename_subst chosen level offset (ht.nth hi) hw

lemma rename_subst (chosen level offset : V) {n p : V} (hp : IsSemiformula L n p) :
    ∀ m vector : V, IsSemitermVec L n m vector →
    rename L chosen level offset (subst L vector p) =
      subst L (termRenameVec L chosen level offset n vector)
        (rename L chosen level offset p) := by
  apply IsSemiformula.pi1_structural_induction (P := fun n p =>
    ∀ m vector : V, IsSemitermVec L n m vector →
    rename L chosen level offset (subst L vector p) =
      subst L (termRenameVec L chosen level offset n vector)
        (rename L chosen level offset p))
    ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ hp
  · definability
  · intro n arity R terms hR ht m vector hw
    rw [substs_rel hR ht.isUTerm,
      rename_rel chosen level offset hR (hw.termSubstVec ht).isUTerm,
      rename_rel chosen level offset hR ht.isUTerm,
      substs_rel hR (termRenameVec_isUTerm chosen level offset ht.isUTerm),
      termRenameVec_subst chosen level offset ht hw]
  · intro n arity R terms hR ht m vector hw
    rw [substs_nrel hR ht.isUTerm,
      rename_nrel chosen level offset hR (hw.termSubstVec ht).isUTerm,
      rename_nrel chosen level offset hR ht.isUTerm,
      substs_nrel hR (termRenameVec_isUTerm chosen level offset ht.isUTerm),
      termRenameVec_subst chosen level offset ht hw]
  · intro n m vector hw; simp
  · intro n m vector hw; simp
  · intro n p q hp hq ihp ihq m vector hw
    rw [substs_and hp.isUFormula hq.isUFormula,
      rename_and chosen level offset (hp.subst hw).isUFormula (hq.subst hw).isUFormula,
      rename_and chosen level offset hp.isUFormula hq.isUFormula,
      substs_and (rename_isUFormula chosen level offset hp.isUFormula)
        (rename_isUFormula chosen level offset hq.isUFormula),ihp m vector hw,ihq m vector hw]
  · intro n p q hp hq ihp ihq m vector hw
    rw [substs_or hp.isUFormula hq.isUFormula,
      rename_or chosen level offset (hp.subst hw).isUFormula (hq.subst hw).isUFormula,
      rename_or chosen level offset hp.isUFormula hq.isUFormula,
      substs_or (rename_isUFormula chosen level offset hp.isUFormula)
        (rename_isUFormula chosen level offset hq.isUFormula),ihp m vector hw,ihq m vector hw]
  · intro n p hp ih m vector hw
    rw [substs_all hp.isUFormula,
      rename_all chosen level offset (hp.subst hw.qVec).isUFormula,
      rename_all chosen level offset hp.isUFormula,
      substs_all (rename_isUFormula chosen level offset hp.isUFormula),
      ih (m+1) (qVec L vector) hw.qVec,termRename_qVec chosen level offset hw]
  · intro n p hp ih m vector hw
    rw [substs_ex hp.isUFormula,
      rename_exs chosen level offset (hp.subst hw.qVec).isUFormula,
      rename_exs chosen level offset hp.isUFormula,
      substs_ex (rename_isUFormula chosen level offset hp.isUFormula),
      ih (m+1) (qVec L vector) hw.qVec,termRename_qVec chosen level offset hw]

lemma termRenameVec_singleton (chosen level offset : V) {term : V} (ht : IsUTerm L term) :
    termRenameVec L chosen level offset 1 (term ∷ 0) =
      termRename L chosen level offset term ∷ 0 := by
  apply nth_ext' 1
  · simp [ht]
  · simp
  · intro i hi
    have : i = 0 := by simpa using hi
    subst i
    simp [nth_termRenameVec,ht]

/-- ALL/eigenvariable commutation, including arbitrary internal free parameters. -/
lemma rename_free_lift (chosen level offset : V) {p : V} (hp : IsSemiformula L 1 p) :
    rename L chosen (level+1) offset (free L p) =
      free L (rename L chosen level offset p) := by
  unfold free substs1
  rw [rename_subst chosen (level+1) offset hp.shift 0 (^&0 ∷ 0) (by simp),
    termRenameVec_singleton chosen (level+1) offset (by simp),
    termRename_fvar,renameIndex_lift_zero,rename_shift_lift chosen level offset hp.isUFormula]

/-- Internal shift-fixed terms have no observable free labels for this renaming. -/
lemma termRename_of_shift_fixed (chosen level offset : V) {term : V}
    (ht : IsUTerm L term) : termShift L term = term →
    termRename L chosen level offset term = term := by
  apply IsUTerm.induction 𝚺 ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ term ht
  · definability
  · intro z _; simp
  · intro x h
    have : x+1 = x := by simpa only [termShift_fvar,qqFvar_inj] using h
    exact False.elim (by simpa using this)
  · intro arity f terms hf hv ih h
    have hvfix : termShiftVec L arity terms = terms := by
      simpa only [termShift_func hf hv,qqFunc_inj,true_and] using h
    rw [termRename_func chosen level offset hf hv]
    apply congrArg (fun args => ^func arity f args)
    apply nth_ext' arity
    · simp [hv]
    · exact hv.lh
    · intro i hi
      rw [nth_termRenameVec chosen level offset hv hi]
      apply ih i hi
      have := congrArg (fun args : V => args.[i]) hvfix
      simpa only [nth_termShiftVec hv hi] using this
lemma termRenameVec_of_shift_fixed (chosen level offset : V) {arity terms : V}
    (ht : IsUTermVec L arity terms) (h : termShiftVec L arity terms = terms) :
    termRenameVec L chosen level offset arity terms = terms := by
  apply nth_ext' arity
  · simp [ht]
  · exact ht.lh
  · intro i hi
    rw [nth_termRenameVec chosen level offset ht hi]
    apply termRename_of_shift_fixed chosen level offset (ht.nth hi)
    have := congrArg (fun args : V => args.[i]) h
    simpa only [nth_termShiftVec ht hi] using this

/-- This is an internal syntax theorem, not an external standard-code argument. -/
lemma rename_of_shift_fixed (chosen level offset : V) {p : V} (hp : IsUFormula L p) :
    shift L p = p → rename L chosen level offset p = p := by
  apply IsUFormula.ISigma1.sigma1_succ_induction ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ p hp
  · definability
  · intro arity R terms hR ht h
    have hterms : termShiftVec L arity terms = terms := by
      simpa only [shift_rel hR ht,qqRel_inj,true_and] using h
    rw [rename_rel chosen level offset hR ht,
      termRenameVec_of_shift_fixed chosen level offset ht hterms]
  · intro arity R terms hR ht h
    have hterms : termShiftVec L arity terms = terms := by
      simpa only [shift_nrel hR ht,qqNRel_inj,true_and] using h
    rw [rename_nrel chosen level offset hR ht,
      termRenameVec_of_shift_fixed chosen level offset ht hterms]
  · intro _; simp
  · intro _; simp
  · intro p q hp hq ihp ihq h
    have hparts : shift L p = p ∧ shift L q = q := by
      simpa only [shift_and hp hq,qqAnd_inj] using h
    rw [rename_and chosen level offset hp hq,ihp hparts.1,ihq hparts.2]
  · intro p q hp hq ihp ihq h
    have hparts : shift L p = p ∧ shift L q = q := by
      simpa only [shift_or hp hq,qqOr_inj] using h
    rw [rename_or chosen level offset hp hq,ihp hparts.1,ihq hparts.2]
  · intro p hp ih h
    have hbody : shift L p = p := by
      simpa only [shift_all hp,qqAll_inj] using h
    rw [rename_all chosen level offset hp,ih hbody]
  · intro p hp ih h
    have hbody : shift L p = p := by
      simpa only [shift_exs hp,qqExs_inj] using h
    rw [rename_exs chosen level offset hp,ih hbody]

lemma rename_neg (chosen level offset : V) {p : V} (hp : IsUFormula L p) :
    rename L chosen level offset (neg L p) = neg L (rename L chosen level offset p) := by
  apply IsUFormula.ISigma1.sigma1_succ_induction ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ p hp
  · definability
  · intro arity R terms hR ht
    simp [hR,ht,rename_rel,rename_nrel,termRenameVec_isUTerm]
  · intro arity R terms hR ht
    simp [hR,ht,rename_rel,rename_nrel,termRenameVec_isUTerm]
  · simp
  · simp
  · intro p q hp hq ihp ihq
    simp [hp,hq,hp.neg,hq.neg,rename_and,rename_or,
      rename_isUFormula,ihp,ihq]
  · intro p q hp hq ihp ihq
    simp [hp,hq,hp.neg,hq.neg,rename_and,rename_or,
      rename_isUFormula,ihp,ihq]
  · intro p hp ih
    simp [hp,hp.neg,rename_all,rename_exs,rename_isUFormula,ih]
  · intro p hp ih
    simp [hp,hp.neg,rename_all,rename_exs,rename_isUFormula,ih]

example (a k s x : V) : renameIndex a (k+1) s (x+1) = renameIndex a k s x+1 :=
  renameIndex_lift_succ a k s x
example (a s x : V) : renameIndex a 0 s (x+1) = renameIndex a 0 (s+1) x :=
  renameIndex_offset_succ a s x
example (a k s d t : V) (ht : IsSemiterm L d t) :
    IsSemiterm L d (termRename L a k s t) := termRename_isSemiterm a k s ht
example (a k s d p : V) (hp : IsSemiformula L d p) :
    IsSemiformula L d (rename L a k s p) := rename_isSemiformula a k s hp
example (a k s p : V) (hp : IsFormula L p) :
    rename L a (k+1) s (shift L p) = shift L (rename L a k s p) :=
  rename_shift_lift a k s hp.isUFormula
example (a s p : V) (hp : IsFormula L p) :
    rename L a 0 s (shift L p) = rename L a 0 (s+1) p :=
  rename_shift_offset a s hp.isUFormula
example (a k s p : V) (hp : IsSemiformula L 1 p) :
    rename L a (k+1) s (free L p) = free L (rename L a k s p) :=
  rename_free_lift a k s hp
example (a k s n m p w : V) (hp : IsSemiformula L n p)
    (hw : IsSemitermVec L n m w) :
    rename L a k s (subst L w p) =
      subst L (termRenameVec L a k s n w) (rename L a k s p) :=
  rename_subst a k s hp m w hw
example (a k s p : V) (hp : IsFormula L p) (hf : shift L p = p) :
    rename L a k s p = p := rename_of_shift_fixed a k s hp.isUFormula hf
example (a k s p : V) (hp : IsFormula L p) :
    rename L a k s (neg L p) = neg L (rename L a k s p) :=
  rename_neg a k s hp.isUFormula
example (a k s p : V) (hp : IsUFormula L p) :
    rename L a k s (^∀ p) = ^∀ (rename L a k s p) := rename_all a k s hp
example (a k s p : V) (hp : IsUFormula L p) :
    rename L a k s (^∃ p) = ^∃ (rename L a k s p) := rename_exs a k s hp
example (a k s x : V) : termRename L a k s (^#x) = ^#x := termRename_bvar a k s x
example (a k s x : V) : termRename L a k s (^&x) = ^&(renameIndex a k s x) := termRename_fvar a k s x

import ZFCinPA.ModelCodedBindOne

/-!
Two-counter free-variable renaming for internal syntax. The fixed graphs are
chosen before the arithmetic model. All indices, parameters and syntax codes
are internal. Bound labels are retained; free labels below `level` are
protected, and the remaining labels use the chosen-label/offset map.

The laws below isolate the SHIFT and ALL hygiene needed by a later bounded
proof-code induction. This module does not itself transport arbitrary internal
proofs, discharge ZF axiom closure, or prove a consistency comparison.
-/
namespace LeanProofs.ZFCinPA.ModelCodedFreeRenaming
open LO LO.FirstOrder LO.FirstOrder.Arithmetic
open LO.FirstOrder.Arithmetic.Bootstrapping
open scoped LO.FirstOrder.Arithmetic
variable {V : Type*} [ORingStructure V] [V↓[ℒₒᵣ] ⊧* 𝗜𝚺₁]
variable {L : Language} [L.Encodable] [L.LORDefinable]

/-- On the unprotected tail this is `lift^level (η_chosen ∘ (+offset))`,
where η sends its chosen label to zero and sends every other label x to x+1.
The additive comparison avoids truncated subtraction in the fixed graph. -/
noncomputable def renameIndex (chosen level offset x : V) : V := by
  classical
  exact if x < level then x else if x+offset = level+chosen then level else x+offset+1

def renameIndexDef : 𝚺₁.Semisentence 5 := .mkSigma “out chosen level offset x.
  (x < level ∧ out = x) ∨
  (level ≤ x ∧ ((x+offset = level+chosen ∧ out = level) ∨
    (x+offset ≠ level+chosen ∧ out = x+offset+1)))”
instance renameIndex_defined :
    𝚺₁-Function₄[V] renameIndex via renameIndexDef := .mk fun e => by
  classical
  by_cases h : e 4 < e 2
  · simp [renameIndexDef,renameIndex,h,not_le.mpr h]
  · have hle : e 2 ≤ e 4 := le_of_not_gt h
    by_cases he : e 4+e 3 = e 2+e 1 <;>
      simp [renameIndexDef,renameIndex,h,hle,he]
instance renameIndex_definable : 𝚫₁-Function₄[V] renameIndex :=
  renameIndex_defined.graph_delta.to_definable

@[simp] lemma renameIndex_lift_zero (chosen level offset : V) :
    renameIndex chosen (level+1) offset 0 = 0 := by
  simp [renameIndex]
lemma renameIndex_lift_succ (chosen level offset x : V) :
    renameIndex chosen (level+1) offset (x+1) =
      renameIndex chosen level offset x+1 := by
  classical
  have hlt : x+1 < level+1 ↔ x < level := by simp
  have heq : (x+1)+offset = (level+1)+chosen ↔ x+offset = level+chosen := by
    constructor
    · intro h
      have h' : (x+offset)+1 = (level+chosen)+1 := by
        simpa only [add_assoc,add_comm,add_left_comm] using h
      exact add_right_cancel h'
    · intro h
      simpa only [add_assoc,add_comm,add_left_comm] using congrArg (fun z : V => z+1) h
  by_cases h : x < level <;> by_cases he : x+offset = level+chosen <;>
    simp only [renameIndex,hlt,heq,h,he,ite_true,ite_false]
  all_goals ac_rfl
lemma renameIndex_offset_succ (chosen offset x : V) :
    renameIndex chosen 0 offset (x+1) = renameIndex chosen 0 (offset+1) x := by
  classical
  simp [renameIndex,add_comm,add_left_comm]

namespace TermRenamer

def blueprint : Language.TermRec.Blueprint 3 where
  bvar := .mkSigma “out z chosen level offset. !qqBvarDef out z”
  fvar := .mkSigma “out x chosen level offset. ∃ y,
    !renameIndexDef y chosen level offset x ∧ !qqFvarDef out y”
  func := .mkSigma “out arity f oldArgs newArgs chosen level offset.
    !qqFuncDef out arity f newArgs”
noncomputable def construction : Language.TermRec.Construction V blueprint where
  bvar _ z := ^#z
  fvar parameters x := ^&(renameIndex (parameters 0) (parameters 1) (parameters 2) x)
  func _ arity f _ newArgs := ^func arity f newArgs
  bvar_defined := .mk fun e => by simp [blueprint]
  fvar_defined := .mk fun e => by simp [blueprint]
  func_defined := .mk fun e => by simp [blueprint]
end TermRenamer

noncomputable def termRename (L : Language) [L.Encodable] [L.LORDefinable]
    (chosen level offset term : V) : V :=
  TermRenamer.construction.result L ![chosen,level,offset] term
noncomputable def termRenameVec (L : Language) [L.Encodable] [L.LORDefinable]
    (chosen level offset arity terms : V) : V :=
  TermRenamer.construction.resultVec L ![chosen,level,offset] arity terms
noncomputable def termRenameDef (L : Language) [L.Encodable] [L.LORDefinable] :
    𝚺₁.Semisentence 5 :=
  (TermRenamer.blueprint.result L).rew (Rew.subst ![#0,#4,#1,#2,#3])
noncomputable def termRenameVecDef (L : Language) [L.Encodable] [L.LORDefinable] :
    𝚺₁.Semisentence 6 :=
  (TermRenamer.blueprint.resultVec L).rew (Rew.subst ![#0,#4,#5,#1,#2,#3])
instance termRename_defined :
    𝚺₁-Function₄[V] (termRename L) via termRenameDef L := .mk fun e => by
  simpa [termRenameDef,termRename,Matrix.comp_vecCons'',Matrix.comp_vecCons']
    using (TermRenamer.construction.result_defined (L := L)).defined
      ![e 0,e 4,e 1,e 2,e 3]
instance termRenameVec_defined :
    𝚺₁-Function₅[V] (termRenameVec L) via termRenameVecDef L := .mk fun e => by
  simpa [termRenameVecDef,termRenameVec,Matrix.comp_vecCons'',Matrix.comp_vecCons']
    using (TermRenamer.construction.resultVec_defined (L := L)).defined
      ![e 0,e 4,e 5,e 1,e 2,e 3]
instance termRename_delta : 𝚫₁-Function₄[V] (termRename L) :=
  termRename_defined.graph_delta.to_definable
instance termRenameVec_delta : 𝚫₁.DefinableFunction₅ (termRenameVec (V := V) L) :=
  termRenameVec_defined.graph_delta.to_definable

@[simp] lemma termRename_bvar (chosen level offset z : V) :
    termRename L chosen level offset (^#z) = ^#z := by
  simp [termRename,TermRenamer.construction]
@[simp] lemma termRename_fvar (chosen level offset x : V) :
    termRename L chosen level offset (^&x) = ^&(renameIndex chosen level offset x) := by
  simp [termRename,TermRenamer.construction]
lemma termRename_func (chosen level offset : V) {arity f terms : V}
    (hf : L.IsFunc arity f) (ht : IsUTermVec L arity terms) :
    termRename L chosen level offset (^func arity f terms) =
      ^func arity f (termRenameVec L chosen level offset arity terms) := by
  simp [termRename,termRenameVec,TermRenamer.construction,hf,ht]
@[simp] lemma termRenameVec_lh (chosen level offset : V) {arity terms : V}
    (ht : IsUTermVec L arity terms) :
    len (termRenameVec L chosen level offset arity terms) = arity :=
  TermRenamer.construction.resultVec_lh L ![chosen,level,offset] ht
lemma nth_termRenameVec (chosen level offset : V) {arity terms i : V}
    (ht : IsUTermVec L arity terms) (hi : i < arity) :
    (termRenameVec L chosen level offset arity terms).[i] =
      termRename L chosen level offset terms.[i] :=
  TermRenamer.construction.nth_resultVec L ![chosen,level,offset] ht hi

lemma termRename_isUTerm (chosen level offset : V) {term : V} (ht : IsUTerm L term) :
    IsUTerm L (termRename L chosen level offset term) := by
  apply IsUTerm.induction 𝚺 ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ term ht
  · definability
  · intro z; simp
  · intro x; simp
  · intro arity f terms hf hv ih
    rw [termRename_func chosen level offset hf hv]
    refine IsUTerm.func hf ⟨(termRenameVec_lh chosen level offset hv).symm,?_⟩
    intro i hi
    rw [nth_termRenameVec chosen level offset hv hi]
    exact ih i hi
lemma termRenameVec_isUTerm (chosen level offset : V) {arity terms : V}
    (ht : IsUTermVec L arity terms) :
    IsUTermVec L arity (termRenameVec L chosen level offset arity terms) := by
  refine ⟨(termRenameVec_lh chosen level offset ht).symm,?_⟩
  intro i hi
  rw [nth_termRenameVec chosen level offset ht hi]
  exact termRename_isUTerm chosen level offset (ht.nth hi)

lemma termRename_isSemiterm (chosen level offset : V) {depth term : V}
    (ht : IsSemiterm L depth term) :
    IsSemiterm L depth (termRename L chosen level offset term) := by
  apply IsSemiterm.induction 𝚺 ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ term ht
  · definability
  · intro z hz; simpa
  · intro x; simp
  · intro arity f terms hf hv ih
    rw [termRename_func chosen level offset hf hv.isUTerm]
    refine IsSemiterm.func.mpr ⟨hf,?_⟩
    apply IsSemitermVec.iff.mpr
    refine ⟨termRenameVec_lh chosen level offset hv.isUTerm,?_⟩
    intro i hi
    rw [nth_termRenameVec chosen level offset hv.isUTerm hi]
    exact ih i hi
lemma termRenameVec_isSemiterm (chosen level offset : V) {depth arity terms : V}
    (ht : IsSemitermVec L arity depth terms) :
    IsSemitermVec L arity depth (termRenameVec L chosen level offset arity terms) := by
  apply IsSemitermVec.iff.mpr
  refine ⟨termRenameVec_lh chosen level offset ht.isUTerm,?_⟩
  intro i hi
  rw [nth_termRenameVec chosen level offset ht.isUTerm hi]
  exact termRename_isSemiterm chosen level offset (ht.nth hi)

namespace FormulaRenamer
noncomputable def blueprint (L : Language) [L.Encodable] [L.LORDefinable] :
    UformulaRec1.Blueprint where
  rel := .mkSigma “out state arity R terms. ∃ chosen, !pi₁Def chosen state ∧
    ∃ rest, !pi₂Def rest state ∧ ∃ level, !pi₁Def level rest ∧
    ∃ offset, !pi₂Def offset rest ∧ ∃ args,
    !(termRenameVecDef L) args chosen level offset arity terms ∧ !qqRelDef out arity R args”
  nrel := .mkSigma “out state arity R terms. ∃ chosen, !pi₁Def chosen state ∧
    ∃ rest, !pi₂Def rest state ∧ ∃ level, !pi₁Def level rest ∧
    ∃ offset, !pi₂Def offset rest ∧ ∃ args,
    !(termRenameVecDef L) args chosen level offset arity terms ∧ !qqNRelDef out arity R args”
  verum := .mkSigma “out state. !qqVerumDef out”
  falsum := .mkSigma “out state. !qqFalsumDef out”
  and := .mkSigma “out state p q left right. !qqAndDef out left right”
  or := .mkSigma “out state p q left right. !qqOrDef out left right”
  all := .mkSigma “out state p body. !qqAllDef out body”
  exs := .mkSigma “out state p body. !qqExsDef out body”
  allChanges := .mkSigma “next state. next = state”
  exsChanges := .mkSigma “next state. next = state”
noncomputable def construction (L : Language) [L.Encodable] [L.LORDefinable] :
    UformulaRec1.Construction V (blueprint L) where
  rel state arity R terms :=
    ^rel arity R (termRenameVec L (π₁ state) (π₁ (π₂ state)) (π₂ (π₂ state)) arity terms)
  nrel state arity R terms :=
    ^nrel arity R (termRenameVec L (π₁ state) (π₁ (π₂ state)) (π₂ (π₂ state)) arity terms)
  verum _ := ^⊤
  falsum _ := ^⊥
  and _ _ _ left right := left ^⋏ right
  or _ _ _ left right := left ^⋎ right
  all _ _ body := ^∀ body
  exs _ _ body := ^∃ body
  allChanges state := state
  exsChanges state := state
  rel_defined := .mk fun e => by simp [blueprint]
  nrel_defined := .mk fun e => by simp [blueprint]
  verum_defined := .mk fun e => by simp [blueprint]
  falsum_defined := .mk fun e => by simp [blueprint]
  and_defined := .mk fun e => by simp [blueprint]
  or_defined := .mk fun e => by simp [blueprint]
  all_defined := .mk fun e => by simp [blueprint]
  exs_defined := .mk fun e => by simp [blueprint]
  allChanges_defined := .mk fun e => by simp [blueprint]
  exChanges_defined := .mk fun e => by simp [blueprint]
end FormulaRenamer

noncomputable def rename (L : Language) [L.Encodable] [L.LORDefinable]
    (chosen level offset formula : V) : V :=
  (FormulaRenamer.construction L).result L ⟪chosen,⟪level,offset⟫⟫ formula
noncomputable def rawRenameDef (L : Language) [L.Encodable] [L.LORDefinable] :
    𝚺₁.Semisentence 3 := (FormulaRenamer.blueprint L).result L
noncomputable def renameDef (L : Language) [L.Encodable] [L.LORDefinable] :
    𝚺₁.Semisentence 5 := .mkSigma “out chosen level offset formula.
      ∃ rest, !pairDef rest level offset ∧ ∃ state, !pairDef state chosen rest ∧
      !(rawRenameDef L) out state formula”
instance rename_defined :
    𝚺₁-Function₄[V] (rename L) via renameDef L := .mk fun e => by
  simpa [renameDef,rawRenameDef,rename]
    using (FormulaRenamer.construction L).result_defined.defined
      ![e 0,⟪e 1,⟪e 2,e 3⟫⟫,e 4]
instance rename_delta : 𝚫₁-Function₄[V] (rename L) :=
  rename_defined.graph_delta.to_definable

lemma rename_rel (chosen level offset : V) {arity R terms : V}
    (hR : L.IsRel arity R) (ht : IsUTermVec L arity terms) :
    rename L chosen level offset (^rel arity R terms) =
      ^rel arity R (termRenameVec L chosen level offset arity terms) := by
  simp [rename,FormulaRenamer.construction,hR,ht]
lemma rename_nrel (chosen level offset : V) {arity R terms : V}
    (hR : L.IsRel arity R) (ht : IsUTermVec L arity terms) :
    rename L chosen level offset (^nrel arity R terms) =
      ^nrel arity R (termRenameVec L chosen level offset arity terms) := by
  simp [rename,FormulaRenamer.construction,hR,ht]
@[simp] lemma rename_verum (chosen level offset : V) :
    rename L chosen level offset ^⊤ = ^⊤ := by
  simp [rename,FormulaRenamer.construction]
@[simp] lemma rename_falsum (chosen level offset : V) :
    rename L chosen level offset ^⊥ = ^⊥ := by
  simp [rename,FormulaRenamer.construction]
lemma rename_and (chosen level offset : V) {p q : V}
    (hp : IsUFormula L p) (hq : IsUFormula L q) :
    rename L chosen level offset (p ^⋏ q) =
      rename L chosen level offset p ^⋏ rename L chosen level offset q := by
  simp [rename,FormulaRenamer.construction,hp,hq]
lemma rename_or (chosen level offset : V) {p q : V}
    (hp : IsUFormula L p) (hq : IsUFormula L q) :
    rename L chosen level offset (p ^⋎ q) =
      rename L chosen level offset p ^⋎ rename L chosen level offset q := by
  simp [rename,FormulaRenamer.construction,hp,hq]
lemma rename_all (chosen level offset : V) {p : V} (hp : IsUFormula L p) :
    rename L chosen level offset (^∀ p) = ^∀ (rename L chosen level offset p) := by
  simp [rename,FormulaRenamer.construction,hp]
lemma rename_exs (chosen level offset : V) {p : V} (hp : IsUFormula L p) :
    rename L chosen level offset (^∃ p) = ^∃ (rename L chosen level offset p) := by
  simp [rename,FormulaRenamer.construction,hp]

lemma rename_isSemiformula (chosen level offset : V) {depth p : V}
    (hp : IsSemiformula L depth p) :
    IsSemiformula L depth (rename L chosen level offset p) := by
  apply IsSemiformula.sigma1_structural_induction (P := fun depth p =>
    IsSemiformula L depth (rename L chosen level offset p))
    ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ hp
  · definability
  · intro depth arity R terms hR ht
    rw [rename_rel chosen level offset hR ht.isUTerm]
    exact IsSemiformula.rel.mpr ⟨hR,termRenameVec_isSemiterm chosen level offset ht⟩
  · intro depth arity R terms hR ht
    rw [rename_nrel chosen level offset hR ht.isUTerm]
    exact IsSemiformula.nrel.mpr ⟨hR,termRenameVec_isSemiterm chosen level offset ht⟩
  · intro depth; simp
  · intro depth; simp
  · intro depth p q hp hq ihp ihq
    rw [rename_and chosen level offset hp.isUFormula hq.isUFormula]
    exact IsSemiformula.and.mpr ⟨ihp,ihq⟩
  · intro depth p q hp hq ihp ihq
    rw [rename_or chosen level offset hp.isUFormula hq.isUFormula]
    exact IsSemiformula.or.mpr ⟨ihp,ihq⟩
  · intro depth p hp ih
    rw [rename_all chosen level offset hp.isUFormula]
    simpa using ih
  · intro depth p hp ih
    rw [rename_exs chosen level offset hp.isUFormula]
    simpa using ih
lemma rename_isUFormula (chosen level offset : V) {p : V} (hp : IsUFormula L p) :
    IsUFormula L (rename L chosen level offset p) :=
  (rename_isSemiformula chosen level offset hp.isSemiformula).isUFormula

lemma termRename_shift_lift (chosen level offset : V) {term : V} (ht : IsUTerm L term) :
    termRename L chosen (level+1) offset (termShift L term) =
      termShift L (termRename L chosen level offset term) := by
  apply IsUTerm.induction 𝚺 ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ term ht
  · definability
  · intro z; simp
  · intro x; simp [renameIndex_lift_succ]
  · intro arity f terms hf hv ih
    rw [termShift_func hf hv,
      termRename_func chosen (level+1) offset hf hv.termShiftVec]
    rw [termRename_func chosen level offset hf hv,
      termShift_func hf (termRenameVec_isUTerm chosen level offset hv)]
    apply congrArg (fun args => ^func arity f args)
    apply nth_ext' arity
    · simp [hv]
    · simp [hv,termRenameVec_isUTerm]
    · intro i hi
      rw [nth_termRenameVec chosen (level+1) offset hv.termShiftVec hi,
        nth_termShiftVec hv hi]
      rw [nth_termShiftVec (termRenameVec_isUTerm chosen level offset hv) hi,
        nth_termRenameVec chosen level offset hv hi]
      exact ih i hi
lemma termRenameVec_shift_lift (chosen level offset : V) {arity terms : V}
    (ht : IsUTermVec L arity terms) :
    termRenameVec L chosen (level+1) offset arity (termShiftVec L arity terms) =
      termShiftVec L arity (termRenameVec L chosen level offset arity terms) := by
  apply nth_ext' arity
  · simp [ht]
  · simp [ht,termRenameVec_isUTerm]
  · intro i hi
    rw [nth_termRenameVec chosen (level+1) offset ht.termShiftVec hi,
      nth_termShiftVec ht hi]
    rw [nth_termShiftVec (termRenameVec_isUTerm chosen level offset ht) hi,
      nth_termRenameVec chosen level offset ht hi]
    exact termRename_shift_lift chosen level offset (ht.nth hi)
/-- Positive-level SHIFT commutation. -/
lemma rename_shift_lift (chosen level offset : V) {p : V} (hp : IsUFormula L p) :
    rename L chosen (level+1) offset (shift L p) = shift L (rename L chosen level offset p) := by
  apply IsUFormula.ISigma1.sigma1_succ_induction ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ p hp
  · definability
  · intro arity R terms hR ht
    rw [shift_rel hR ht,rename_rel chosen (level+1) offset hR ht.termShiftVec,
      termRenameVec_shift_lift chosen level offset ht,
      rename_rel chosen level offset hR ht]
    rw [shift_rel hR (termRenameVec_isUTerm chosen level offset ht)]
  · intro arity R terms hR ht
    rw [shift_nrel hR ht,rename_nrel chosen (level+1) offset hR ht.termShiftVec,
      termRenameVec_shift_lift chosen level offset ht,
      rename_nrel chosen level offset hR ht]
    rw [shift_nrel hR (termRenameVec_isUTerm chosen level offset ht)]
  · simp
  · simp
  · intro p q hp hq ihp ihq
    rw [shift_and hp hq,
      rename_and chosen (level+1) offset hp.shift hq.shift,
      rename_and chosen level offset hp hq,ihp,ihq]
    rw [shift_and (rename_isUFormula chosen level offset hp)
      (rename_isUFormula chosen level offset hq)]
  · intro p q hp hq ihp ihq
    rw [shift_or hp hq,
      rename_or chosen (level+1) offset hp.shift hq.shift,
      rename_or chosen level offset hp hq,ihp,ihq]
    rw [shift_or (rename_isUFormula chosen level offset hp)
      (rename_isUFormula chosen level offset hq)]
  · intro p hp ih
    rw [shift_all hp,rename_all chosen (level+1) offset hp.shift,
      rename_all chosen level offset hp,ih]
    rw [shift_all (rename_isUFormula chosen level offset hp)]
  · intro p hp ih
    rw [shift_exs hp,rename_exs chosen (level+1) offset hp.shift,
      rename_exs chosen level offset hp,ih]
    rw [shift_exs (rename_isUFormula chosen level offset hp)]

lemma termRename_shift_offset (chosen offset : V) {term : V} (ht : IsUTerm L term) :
    termRename L chosen 0 offset (termShift L term) =
      termRename L chosen 0 (offset+1) term := by
  apply IsUTerm.induction 𝚺 ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ term ht
  · definability
  · intro z; simp
  · intro x; simp [renameIndex_offset_succ]
  · intro arity f terms hf hv ih
    rw [termShift_func hf hv,
      termRename_func chosen 0 offset hf hv.termShiftVec]
    rw [termRename_func chosen 0 (offset+1) hf hv]
    apply congrArg (fun args => ^func arity f args)
    apply nth_ext' arity
    · simp [hv]
    · simp [hv]
    · intro i hi
      rw [nth_termRenameVec chosen 0 offset hv.termShiftVec hi,
        nth_termShiftVec hv hi]
      rw [nth_termRenameVec chosen 0 (offset+1) hv hi]
      exact ih i hi
lemma termRenameVec_shift_offset (chosen offset : V) {arity terms : V}
    (ht : IsUTermVec L arity terms) :
    termRenameVec L chosen 0 offset arity (termShiftVec L arity terms) =
      termRenameVec L chosen 0 (offset+1) arity terms := by
  apply nth_ext' arity
  · simp [ht]
  · simp [ht]
  · intro i hi
    rw [nth_termRenameVec chosen 0 offset ht.termShiftVec hi,
      nth_termShiftVec ht hi]
    rw [nth_termRenameVec chosen 0 (offset+1) ht hi]
    exact termRename_shift_offset chosen offset (ht.nth hi)
/-- The level-zero SHIFT case consumes one offset instead of requiring an inverse SHIFT. -/
lemma rename_shift_offset (chosen offset : V) {p : V} (hp : IsUFormula L p) :
    rename L chosen 0 offset (shift L p) = rename L chosen 0 (offset+1) p := by
  apply IsUFormula.ISigma1.sigma1_succ_induction ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ p hp
  · definability
  · intro arity R terms hR ht
    rw [shift_rel hR ht,rename_rel chosen 0 offset hR ht.termShiftVec,
      termRenameVec_shift_offset chosen offset ht,
      rename_rel chosen 0 (offset+1) hR ht]
  · intro arity R terms hR ht
    rw [shift_nrel hR ht,rename_nrel chosen 0 offset hR ht.termShiftVec,
      termRenameVec_shift_offset chosen offset ht,
      rename_nrel chosen 0 (offset+1) hR ht]
  · simp
  · simp
  · intro p q hp hq ihp ihq
    rw [shift_and hp hq,
      rename_and chosen 0 offset hp.shift hq.shift,
      rename_and chosen 0 (offset+1) hp hq,ihp,ihq]
  · intro p q hp hq ihp ihq
    rw [shift_or hp hq,
      rename_or chosen 0 offset hp.shift hq.shift,
      rename_or chosen 0 (offset+1) hp hq,ihp,ihq]
  · intro p hp ih
    rw [shift_all hp,rename_all chosen 0 offset hp.shift,
      rename_all chosen 0 (offset+1) hp,ih]
  · intro p hp ih
    rw [shift_exs hp,rename_exs chosen 0 offset hp.shift,
      rename_exs chosen 0 (offset+1) hp,ih]

lemma termRename_bShift (chosen level offset : V) {term : V} (ht : IsUTerm L term) :
    termRename L chosen level offset (termBShift L term) =
      termBShift L (termRename L chosen level offset term) := by
  apply IsUTerm.induction 𝚺 ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ term ht
  · definability
  · intro z; simp
  · intro x; simp
  · intro arity f terms hf hv ih
    rw [termBShift_func hf hv,
      termRename_func chosen level offset hf hv.isSemitermVec.termBShiftVec.isUTerm,
      termRename_func chosen level offset hf hv,
      termBShift_func hf (termRenameVec_isUTerm chosen level offset hv)]
    apply congrArg (fun args => ^func arity f args)
    apply nth_ext' arity
    · exact termRenameVec_lh chosen level offset hv.isSemitermVec.termBShiftVec.isUTerm
    · simp [hv,termRenameVec_isUTerm]
    · intro i hi
      rw [nth_termRenameVec chosen level offset hv.isSemitermVec.termBShiftVec.isUTerm hi,
        nth_termBShiftVec hv hi,
        nth_termBShiftVec (termRenameVec_isUTerm chosen level offset hv) hi,
        nth_termRenameVec chosen level offset hv hi]
      exact ih i hi
lemma termRename_qVec (chosen level offset : V) {n m vector : V}
    (hw : IsSemitermVec L n m vector) :
    termRenameVec L chosen level offset (n+1) (qVec L vector) =
      qVec L (termRenameVec L chosen level offset n vector) := by
  apply nth_ext' (n+1)
  · exact termRenameVec_lh chosen level offset hw.qVec.isUTerm
  · exact len_qVec (termRenameVec_isUTerm chosen level offset hw.isUTerm)
  · intro i hi
    rw [nth_termRenameVec chosen level offset hw.qVec.isUTerm hi]
    rcases zero_or_succ i with rfl | ⟨i,rfl⟩
    · simp [Bootstrapping.qVec]
    · have hin : i < n := by simpa using hi
      simp only [Bootstrapping.qVec,nth_adjoin_succ,hw.lh,
        termRenameVec_lh chosen level offset hw.isUTerm]
      rw [nth_termBShiftVec hw.isUTerm hin,
        nth_termBShiftVec (termRenameVec_isUTerm chosen level offset hw.isUTerm)
          (by simpa using hin),
        nth_termRenameVec chosen level offset hw.isUTerm hin,
        termRename_bShift chosen level offset (hw.nth hin).isUTerm]

lemma termRename_subst (chosen level offset : V) {n m term vector : V}
    (ht : IsSemiterm L n term) (hw : IsSemitermVec L n m vector) :
    termRename L chosen level offset (termSubst L vector term) =
      termSubst L (termRenameVec L chosen level offset n vector)
        (termRename L chosen level offset term) := by
  apply IsSemiterm.induction 𝚺 ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ term ht
  · definability
  · intro z hz
    simp [termSubst_bvar,nth_termRenameVec chosen level offset hw.isUTerm hz]
  · intro x; simp
  · intro arity f terms hf hv ih
    rw [termSubst_func hf hv.isUTerm,
      termRename_func chosen level offset hf (hw.termSubstVec hv).isUTerm,
      termRename_func chosen level offset hf hv.isUTerm,
      termSubst_func hf (termRenameVec_isUTerm chosen level offset hv.isUTerm)]
    apply congrArg (fun args => ^func arity f args)
    apply nth_ext' arity
    · exact termRenameVec_lh chosen level offset (hw.termSubstVec hv).isUTerm
    · simp [termRenameVec_isUTerm chosen level offset hv.isUTerm]
    · intro i hi
      rw [nth_termRenameVec chosen level offset (hw.termSubstVec hv).isUTerm hi,
        nth_termSubstVec hv.isUTerm hi,
        nth_termSubstVec (termRenameVec_isUTerm chosen level offset hv.isUTerm) hi,
        nth_termRenameVec chosen level offset hv.isUTerm hi]
      exact ih i hi
lemma termRenameVec_subst (chosen level offset : V) {n m arity terms vector : V}
    (ht : IsSemitermVec L arity n terms) (hw : IsSemitermVec L n m vector) :
    termRenameVec L chosen level offset arity (termSubstVec L arity vector terms) =
      termSubstVec L arity (termRenameVec L chosen level offset n vector)
        (termRenameVec L chosen level offset arity terms) := by
  apply nth_ext' arity
  · exact termRenameVec_lh chosen level offset (hw.termSubstVec ht).isUTerm
  · simp [termRenameVec_isUTerm chosen level offset ht.isUTerm]
  · intro i hi
    rw [nth_termRenameVec chosen level offset (hw.termSubstVec ht).isUTerm hi,
      nth_termSubstVec ht.isUTerm hi,
      nth_termSubstVec (termRenameVec_isUTerm chosen level offset ht.isUTerm) hi,
      nth_termRenameVec chosen level offset ht.isUTerm hi]
    exact termRename_subst chosen level offset (ht.nth hi) hw

lemma rename_subst (chosen level offset : V) {n p : V} (hp : IsSemiformula L n p) :
    ∀ m vector : V, IsSemitermVec L n m vector →
    rename L chosen level offset (subst L vector p) =
      subst L (termRenameVec L chosen level offset n vector)
        (rename L chosen level offset p) := by
  apply IsSemiformula.pi1_structural_induction (P := fun n p =>
    ∀ m vector : V, IsSemitermVec L n m vector →
    rename L chosen level offset (subst L vector p) =
      subst L (termRenameVec L chosen level offset n vector)
        (rename L chosen level offset p))
    ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ hp
  · definability
  · intro n arity R terms hR ht m vector hw
    rw [substs_rel hR ht.isUTerm,
      rename_rel chosen level offset hR (hw.termSubstVec ht).isUTerm,
      rename_rel chosen level offset hR ht.isUTerm,
      substs_rel hR (termRenameVec_isUTerm chosen level offset ht.isUTerm),
      termRenameVec_subst chosen level offset ht hw]
  · intro n arity R terms hR ht m vector hw
    rw [substs_nrel hR ht.isUTerm,
      rename_nrel chosen level offset hR (hw.termSubstVec ht).isUTerm,
      rename_nrel chosen level offset hR ht.isUTerm,
      substs_nrel hR (termRenameVec_isUTerm chosen level offset ht.isUTerm),
      termRenameVec_subst chosen level offset ht hw]
  · intro n m vector hw; simp
  · intro n m vector hw; simp
  · intro n p q hp hq ihp ihq m vector hw
    rw [substs_and hp.isUFormula hq.isUFormula,
      rename_and chosen level offset (hp.subst hw).isUFormula (hq.subst hw).isUFormula,
      rename_and chosen level offset hp.isUFormula hq.isUFormula,
      substs_and (rename_isUFormula chosen level offset hp.isUFormula)
        (rename_isUFormula chosen level offset hq.isUFormula),ihp m vector hw,ihq m vector hw]
  · intro n p q hp hq ihp ihq m vector hw
    rw [substs_or hp.isUFormula hq.isUFormula,
      rename_or chosen level offset (hp.subst hw).isUFormula (hq.subst hw).isUFormula,
      rename_or chosen level offset hp.isUFormula hq.isUFormula,
      substs_or (rename_isUFormula chosen level offset hp.isUFormula)
        (rename_isUFormula chosen level offset hq.isUFormula),ihp m vector hw,ihq m vector hw]
  · intro n p hp ih m vector hw
    rw [substs_all hp.isUFormula,
      rename_all chosen level offset (hp.subst hw.qVec).isUFormula,
      rename_all chosen level offset hp.isUFormula,
      substs_all (rename_isUFormula chosen level offset hp.isUFormula),
      ih (m+1) (qVec L vector) hw.qVec,termRename_qVec chosen level offset hw]
  · intro n p hp ih m vector hw
    rw [substs_ex hp.isUFormula,
      rename_exs chosen level offset (hp.subst hw.qVec).isUFormula,
      rename_exs chosen level offset hp.isUFormula,
      substs_ex (rename_isUFormula chosen level offset hp.isUFormula),
      ih (m+1) (qVec L vector) hw.qVec,termRename_qVec chosen level offset hw]

lemma termRenameVec_singleton (chosen level offset : V) {term : V} (ht : IsUTerm L term) :
    termRenameVec L chosen level offset 1 (term ∷ 0) =
      termRename L chosen level offset term ∷ 0 := by
  apply nth_ext' 1
  · simp [ht]
  · simp
  · intro i hi
    have : i = 0 := by simpa using hi
    subst i
    simp [nth_termRenameVec,ht]

/-- ALL/eigenvariable commutation, including arbitrary internal free parameters. -/
lemma rename_free_lift (chosen level offset : V) {p : V} (hp : IsSemiformula L 1 p) :
    rename L chosen (level+1) offset (free L p) =
      free L (rename L chosen level offset p) := by
  unfold free substs1
  rw [rename_subst chosen (level+1) offset hp.shift 0 (^&0 ∷ 0) (by simp),
    termRenameVec_singleton chosen (level+1) offset (by simp),
    termRename_fvar,renameIndex_lift_zero,rename_shift_lift chosen level offset hp.isUFormula]

/-- Internal shift-fixed terms have no observable free labels for this renaming. -/
lemma termRename_of_shift_fixed (chosen level offset : V) {term : V}
    (ht : IsUTerm L term) : termShift L term = term →
    termRename L chosen level offset term = term := by
  apply IsUTerm.induction 𝚺 ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ term ht
  · definability
  · intro z _; simp
  · intro x h
    have : x+1 = x := by simpa only [termShift_fvar,qqFvar_inj] using h
    exact False.elim (by simp at this)
  · intro arity f terms hf hv ih h
    have hvfix : termShiftVec L arity terms = terms := by
      simpa only [termShift_func hf hv,qqFunc_inj,true_and] using h
    rw [termRename_func chosen level offset hf hv]
    apply congrArg (fun args => ^func arity f args)
    apply nth_ext' arity
    · simp [hv]
    · exact hv.lh.symm
    · intro i hi
      rw [nth_termRenameVec chosen level offset hv hi]
      apply ih i hi
      have := congrArg (fun args : V => args.[i]) hvfix
      simpa only [nth_termShiftVec hv hi] using this
lemma termRenameVec_of_shift_fixed (chosen level offset : V) {arity terms : V}
    (ht : IsUTermVec L arity terms) (h : termShiftVec L arity terms = terms) :
    termRenameVec L chosen level offset arity terms = terms := by
  apply nth_ext' arity
  · simp [ht]
  · exact ht.lh.symm
  · intro i hi
    rw [nth_termRenameVec chosen level offset ht hi]
    apply termRename_of_shift_fixed chosen level offset (ht.nth hi)
    have := congrArg (fun args : V => args.[i]) h
    simpa only [nth_termShiftVec ht hi] using this

/-- This is an internal syntax theorem, not an external standard-code argument. -/
lemma rename_of_shift_fixed (chosen level offset : V) {p : V} (hp : IsUFormula L p) :
    shift L p = p → rename L chosen level offset p = p := by
  apply IsUFormula.ISigma1.sigma1_succ_induction ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ p hp
  · definability
  · intro arity R terms hR ht h
    have hterms : termShiftVec L arity terms = terms := by
      simpa only [shift_rel hR ht,qqRel_inj,true_and] using h
    rw [rename_rel chosen level offset hR ht,
      termRenameVec_of_shift_fixed chosen level offset ht hterms]
  · intro arity R terms hR ht h
    have hterms : termShiftVec L arity terms = terms := by
      simpa only [shift_nrel hR ht,qqNRel_inj,true_and] using h
    rw [rename_nrel chosen level offset hR ht,
      termRenameVec_of_shift_fixed chosen level offset ht hterms]
  · intro _; simp
  · intro _; simp
  · intro p q hp hq ihp ihq h
    have hparts : shift L p = p ∧ shift L q = q := by
      simpa only [shift_and hp hq,qqAnd_inj] using h
    rw [rename_and chosen level offset hp hq,ihp hparts.1,ihq hparts.2]
  · intro p q hp hq ihp ihq h
    have hparts : shift L p = p ∧ shift L q = q := by
      simpa only [shift_or hp hq,qqOr_inj] using h
    rw [rename_or chosen level offset hp hq,ihp hparts.1,ihq hparts.2]
  · intro p hp ih h
    have hbody : shift L p = p := by
      simpa only [shift_all hp,qqAll_inj] using h
    rw [rename_all chosen level offset hp,ih hbody]
  · intro p hp ih h
    have hbody : shift L p = p := by
      simpa only [shift_exs hp,qqExs_inj] using h

import ZFCinPA.ModelCodedFreeRenaming

/-!
Actual ZF/ZFC axiom invariance under represented free renaming. The finite
axiom recognizers contain only quotes of ordinary sentences. The two schema
recognizers explicitly supply a shift-fixed body and an internal number of
universal binders. This uses those literal witnesses; it does not postulate
semantic closure of a theory or a proof selector.
-/
namespace LeanProofs.ZFCinPA.ModelCodedRenamingAxioms
open LO LO.FirstOrder LO.FirstOrder.Arithmetic
open LO.FirstOrder.Arithmetic.Bootstrapping LO.FirstOrder.SetTheory
open LeanProofs.ZFCinPA LeanProofs.ZFCinPA.ModelCodedFreeRenaming
open scoped LO.FirstOrder.Arithmetic
variable {V : Type*} [ORingStructure V] [V↓[ℒₒᵣ] ⊧* 𝗜𝚺₁]
variable {L : Language} [L.Encodable] [L.LORDefinable]

lemma shift_qqAlls {body : V} (hb : IsUFormula L body) (count : V) :
    shift L (qqAlls body count) = qqAlls (shift L body) count := by
  induction count using ISigma1.sigma1_succ_induction
  · definability
  case zero => simp
  case succ count ih =>
    rw [qqAlls_succ,shift_all (isUFormula_qqAlls.mpr hb),ih,qqAlls_succ]

lemma sentence_quote_shift_fixed (sentence : Sentence L) :
    shift L (⌜sentence⌝ : V) = ⌜sentence⌝ := by
  have hs : Rewriting.shift (sentence : Proposition L) = (sentence : Proposition L) := by
    simpa using FirstOrder.Semiformula.rew_univCl' (sentence : Proposition L) Rew.shift
  rw [FirstOrder.Sentence.quote_def,←FirstOrder.Semiformula.quote_shift,hs]

/-- The finite recognizer cannot acquire new nonstandard axiom codes. -/
lemma ofList_class_iff (sentences : List (Sentence L)) (p : V) :
    letI := Theory.Δ₁.ofList sentences
    p ∈ ({sentence | sentence ∈ sentences} : Theory L).Δ₁Class ↔
      ∃ sentence ∈ sentences, p = (⌜sentence⌝ : V) := by
  induction sentences with
  | nil => simp [Theory.Δ₁Class,Theory.Δ₁.ofList,Theory.Δ₁.empty]
  | cons sentence sentences ih =>
    have ih' : (V ⊧/![p] (Theory.Δ₁.ofList sentences).ch.val) ↔
        ∃ sentence ∈ sentences, p = (⌜sentence⌝ : V) := ih
    change ((p = (Encodable.encode sentence : V)) ∨
      (V ⊧/![p] (Theory.Δ₁.ofList sentences).ch.val)) ↔ _
    rw [ih']
    simp [FirstOrder.Sentence.quote_eq_encode]

lemma ofList_class_shift_fixed (sentences : List (Sentence L)) {p : V} :
    letI := Theory.Δ₁.ofList sentences
    p ∈ ({sentence | sentence ∈ sentences} : Theory L).Δ₁Class → shift L p = p := by
  intro hp
  rcases (ofList_class_iff sentences p).mp hp with ⟨sentence,_,rfl⟩
  exact sentence_quote_shift_fixed sentence

lemma ofFinite_class_shift_fixed (T : Theory L) (finite : Set.Finite T) {p : V} :
    letI := Theory.Δ₁.ofFinite T finite
    p ∈ T.Δ₁Class → shift L p = p := by
  simpa only [Theory.Δ₁.ofFinite,Theory.Δ₁.ofEq] using
    (ofList_class_shift_fixed (V := V) finite.toFinset.toList (p := p))

lemma union_class_iff (T U : Theory L) [T.Δ₁] [U.Δ₁] (p : V) :
    p ∈ (T ∪ U).Δ₁Class ↔ p ∈ T.Δ₁Class ∨ p ∈ U.Δ₁Class := by
  change (V ⊧/![p] (T.Δ₁ch ⋎ U.Δ₁ch).val) ↔ _
  simp only [HierarchySymbol.Semiformula.val_or,Semiformula.eval_or]
  rfl

/-- Every literal schema recognizer supplies the needed closed syntax. -/
lemma schemaRecognizer_shift_fixed {arity : Nat} {Fval : V → V} {p : V}
    (hp : SchemaRecognizer L arity Fval p) : shift L p = p := by
  rcases hp with ⟨count,_,body,_,rfl,hbody,hfixed,_,_⟩
  rw [shift_qqAlls hbody,hfixed]

lemma zf_axiom_shift_fixed {p : V} (hp : p ∈ (𝗭𝗙 : SetTheory).Δ₁Class) :
    shift ℒₛₑₜ p = p := by
  have hcases : p ∈ (𝗘𝗤 ℒₛₑₜ : SetTheory).Δ₁Class ∨
      p ∈ zfFixed.Δ₁Class ∨ p ∈ separationTheory.Δ₁Class ∨
      p ∈ replacementTheory.Δ₁Class := by
    change p ∈ (𝗘𝗤 ℒₛₑₜ ∪ zfFixed ∪ separationTheory ∪ replacementTheory : SetTheory).Δ₁Class at hp
    simpa only [union_class_iff,or_assoc] using hp
  rcases hcases with heq | hfixed | hsep | hrep
  · exact ofFinite_class_shift_fixed (𝗘𝗤 ℒₛₑₜ : SetTheory) Theory.EqAxiom.finite heq
  · change (letI := Theory.Δ₁.ofList
      [Axiom.empty,Axiom.extentionality,Axiom.pairing,Axiom.union,
       Axiom.power,Axiom.infinity,Axiom.foundation]
      p ∈ ({sentence | sentence ∈
        [Axiom.empty,Axiom.extentionality,Axiom.pairing,Axiom.union,
         Axiom.power,Axiom.infinity,Axiom.foundation]} : SetTheory).Δ₁Class) at hfixed
    exact ofList_class_shift_fixed _ hfixed
  · have h : SepR p := by
      change (V ⊧/![p] sepCh.val) at hsep
      simpa using hsep
    exact schemaRecognizer_shift_fixed h
  · have h : RepR p := by
      change (V ⊧/![p] repCh.val) at hrep
      simpa using hrep
    exact schemaRecognizer_shift_fixed h

lemma zfc_axiom_shift_fixed {p : V} (hp : p ∈ (𝗭𝗙𝗖 : SetTheory).Δ₁Class) :
    shift ℒₛₑₜ p = p := by
  change p ∈ ((𝗭𝗙 : SetTheory) ∪ 𝗔𝗖).Δ₁Class at hp
  rcases (union_class_iff (𝗭𝗙 : SetTheory) 𝗔𝗖 p).mp hp with hzf | hac
  · exact zf_axiom_shift_fixed hzf
  · have h : p = (⌜Axiom.choice⌝ : V) := by
      change (V ⊧/![p] “x. x = ↑(Encodable.encode Axiom.choice)”) at hac
      simpa [FirstOrder.Sentence.quote_eq_encode] using hac
    rw [h]
    exact sentence_quote_shift_fixed Axiom.choice

/-- Actual axiom closure, not a premise about arbitrary semantic schemas. -/
theorem zf_axiom_rename (chosen level offset : V) {p : V}
    (hformula : IsFormula ℒₛₑₜ p) (hp : p ∈ (𝗭𝗙 : SetTheory).Δ₁Class) :
    rename ℒₛₑₜ chosen level offset p = p :=
  rename_of_shift_fixed chosen level offset hformula.isUFormula (zf_axiom_shift_fixed hp)
theorem zfc_axiom_rename (chosen level offset : V) {p : V}
    (hformula : IsFormula ℒₛₑₜ p) (hp : p ∈ (𝗭𝗙𝗖 : SetTheory).Δ₁Class) :
    rename ℒₛₑₜ chosen level offset p = p :=
  rename_of_shift_fixed chosen level offset hformula.isUFormula (zfc_axiom_shift_fixed hp)

theorem zf_rename_mem (chosen level offset : V) {p : V}
    (hformula : IsFormula ℒₛₑₜ p) (hp : p ∈ (𝗭𝗙 : SetTheory).Δ₁Class) :
    rename ℒₛₑₜ chosen level offset p ∈ (𝗭𝗙 : SetTheory).Δ₁Class := by
  rw [zf_axiom_rename chosen level offset hformula hp]
  exact hp
theorem zfc_rename_mem (chosen level offset : V) {p : V}
    (hformula : IsFormula ℒₛₑₜ p) (hp : p ∈ (𝗭𝗙𝗖 : SetTheory).Δ₁Class) :
    rename ℒₛₑₜ chosen level offset p ∈ (𝗭𝗙𝗖 : SetTheory).Δ₁Class := by
  rw [zfc_axiom_rename chosen level offset hformula hp]
  exact hp

end LeanProofs.ZFCinPA.ModelCodedRenamingAxioms

open LeanProofs.ZFCinPA.ModelCodedFreeRenaming

#print axioms LeanProofs.ZFCinPA.ModelCodedRenamingAxioms.schemaRecognizer_shift_fixed

example (p : V) (hp : p ∈ (𝗭𝗙 : SetTheory).Δ₁Class) : shift ℒₛₑₜ p = p :=

example (p : V) (hp : p ∈ (𝗭𝗙𝗖 : SetTheory).Δ₁Class) : shift ℒₛₑₜ p = p :=

import ZFCinPA.ModelCodedFreeRenaming

/-!
Exact syntax connection to the checked named binder: reopening its new bound
slot with free label zero after a free-label SHIFT is the two-counter renaming
at level/offset zero. This is not yet the proof transport needed for GEN.
-/
namespace LeanProofs.ZFCinPA.ModelCodedRenamingBindOne
open LO LO.FirstOrder LO.FirstOrder.Arithmetic
open LO.FirstOrder.Arithmetic.Bootstrapping
open LeanProofs.ZFCinPA.ModelCodedSpecialization
open LeanProofs.ZFCinPA.ModelCodedBindOne
open LeanProofs.ZFCinPA.ModelCodedFreeRenaming
open scoped LO.FirstOrder.Arithmetic
variable {V : Type*} [ORingStructure V] [V↓[ℒₒᵣ] ⊧* 𝗜𝚺₁]
variable {L : Language} [L.Encodable] [L.LORDefinable]

lemma termBindOneAt_free {depth term : V} (ht : IsSemiterm L depth term) :
    ∀ chosen : V,
    termSubst L (qVecIter L depth (^&0 ∷ 0))
      (termShift L (termBindOneAt L chosen depth term)) =
        termRename L chosen 0 0 term := by
  apply IsSemiterm.induction 𝚷 ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ term ht
  · definability
  · intro z hz chosen
    rw [termBindOneAt_bvar,termShift_bvar,termSubst_bvar,termRename_bvar]
    exact (qVecIter_free_spec depth 0).1 z hz
  · intro x chosen
    classical
    by_cases h : x = chosen
    · rw [h,termBindOneAt_chosen,termShift_bvar,termSubst_bvar,
        (qVecIter_free_spec depth 0).2,termRename_fvar]
      simp [renameIndex]
    · rw [termBindOneAt_other chosen depth x h,termShift_fvar,
        termSubst_fvar,termRename_fvar]
      simp [renameIndex,h]
  · intro arity f terms hf hv ih chosen
    rw [termBindOneAt_func chosen depth hf hv.isUTerm,
      termShift_func hf (termBindOneVecAt_isUTerm chosen depth hv.isUTerm),
      termSubst_func hf (termBindOneVecAt_isUTerm chosen depth hv.isUTerm).termShiftVec,
      termRename_func chosen 0 0 hf hv.isUTerm]
    apply congrArg (fun args => ^func arity f args)
    apply nth_ext' arity
    · simp [termBindOneVecAt_isUTerm chosen depth hv.isUTerm]
    · simp [hv.isUTerm]
    · intro i hi
      rw [nth_termSubstVec
          (termBindOneVecAt_isUTerm chosen depth hv.isUTerm).termShiftVec hi,
        nth_termShiftVec (termBindOneVecAt_isUTerm chosen depth hv.isUTerm) hi,
        nth_termBindOneVecAt chosen depth hv.isUTerm hi,
        nth_termRenameVec chosen 0 0 hv.isUTerm hi]
      exact ih i hi chosen

lemma termBindOneVecAt_free {depth arity terms : V}
    (ht : IsSemitermVec L arity depth terms) (chosen : V) :
    termSubstVec L arity (qVecIter L depth (^&0 ∷ 0))
      (termShiftVec L arity (termBindOneVecAt L chosen depth arity terms)) =
        termRenameVec L chosen 0 0 arity terms := by
  apply nth_ext' arity
  · simp [termBindOneVecAt_isUTerm chosen depth ht.isUTerm]
  · simp [ht.isUTerm]
  · intro i hi
    rw [nth_termSubstVec (termBindOneVecAt_isUTerm chosen depth ht.isUTerm).termShiftVec hi,
      nth_termShiftVec (termBindOneVecAt_isUTerm chosen depth ht.isUTerm) hi,
      nth_termBindOneVecAt chosen depth ht.isUTerm hi,
      nth_termRenameVec chosen 0 0 ht.isUTerm hi]
    exact termBindOneAt_free (ht.nth hi) chosen

lemma bindOneAt_free {depth p : V} (hp : IsSemiformula L depth p) :
    ∀ chosen : V,
    subst L (qVecIter L depth (^&0 ∷ 0)) (shift L (bindOneAt L chosen depth p)) =
      rename L chosen 0 0 p := by
  apply IsSemiformula.pi1_structural_induction (P := fun depth p =>
    ∀ chosen : V,
    subst L (qVecIter L depth (^&0 ∷ 0)) (shift L (bindOneAt L chosen depth p)) =
      rename L chosen 0 0 p)
    ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ hp
  · definability
  · intro depth arity R terms hR ht chosen
    rw [bindOneAt_rel chosen depth hR ht.isUTerm,
      shift_rel hR (termBindOneVecAt_isUTerm chosen depth ht.isUTerm),
      substs_rel hR (termBindOneVecAt_isUTerm chosen depth ht.isUTerm).termShiftVec,
      termBindOneVecAt_free ht chosen,rename_rel chosen 0 0 hR ht.isUTerm]
  · intro depth arity R terms hR ht chosen
    rw [bindOneAt_nrel chosen depth hR ht.isUTerm,
      shift_nrel hR (termBindOneVecAt_isUTerm chosen depth ht.isUTerm),
      substs_nrel hR (termBindOneVecAt_isUTerm chosen depth ht.isUTerm).termShiftVec,
      termBindOneVecAt_free ht chosen,rename_nrel chosen 0 0 hR ht.isUTerm]
  · intro depth chosen; simp
  · intro depth chosen; simp
  · intro depth p q hp hq ihp ihq chosen
    rw [bindOneAt_and chosen depth hp.isUFormula hq.isUFormula,
      shift_and (bindOneAt_isSemiformula hp chosen).isUFormula
        (bindOneAt_isSemiformula hq chosen).isUFormula,
      substs_and (bindOneAt_isSemiformula hp chosen).shift.isUFormula
        (bindOneAt_isSemiformula hq chosen).shift.isUFormula,
      ihp chosen,ihq chosen,rename_and chosen 0 0 hp.isUFormula hq.isUFormula]
  · intro depth p q hp hq ihp ihq chosen
    rw [bindOneAt_or chosen depth hp.isUFormula hq.isUFormula,
      shift_or (bindOneAt_isSemiformula hp chosen).isUFormula
        (bindOneAt_isSemiformula hq chosen).isUFormula,
      substs_or (bindOneAt_isSemiformula hp chosen).shift.isUFormula
        (bindOneAt_isSemiformula hq chosen).shift.isUFormula,
      ihp chosen,ihq chosen,rename_or chosen 0 0 hp.isUFormula hq.isUFormula]
  · intro depth p hp ih chosen
    rw [bindOneAt_all chosen depth hp.isUFormula,
      shift_all (bindOneAt_isSemiformula hp chosen).isUFormula,
      substs_all (bindOneAt_isSemiformula hp chosen).shift.isUFormula,
      ←qVecIter_succ,ih chosen,rename_all chosen 0 0 hp.isUFormula]
  · intro depth p hp ih chosen
    rw [bindOneAt_exs chosen depth hp.isUFormula,
      shift_exs (bindOneAt_isSemiformula hp chosen).isUFormula,
      substs_ex (bindOneAt_isSemiformula hp chosen).shift.isUFormula,
      ←qVecIter_succ,ih chosen,rename_exs chosen 0 0 hp.isUFormula]

/-- The literal ALL premise needed for `namedAll`, for all internal formulas. -/
theorem free_bindOneAt {p : V} (hp : IsFormula L p) (chosen : V) :
    free L (bindOneAt L chosen 0 p) = rename L chosen 0 0 p := by
  simpa [free,substs1] using bindOneAt_free hp chosen

end LeanProofs.ZFCinPA.ModelCodedRenamingBindOne

open scoped LO.FirstOrder.Arithmetic
variable {V : Type*} [ORingStructure V] [V↓[ℒₒᵣ] ⊧* 𝗜𝚺₁]
variable {L : Language} [L.Encodable] [L.LORDefinable]

#print axioms LeanProofs.ZFCinPA.ModelCodedRenamingBindOne.bindOneAt_free

example (a d p : V) (hp : IsSemiformula L d p) :
